slides.title:
Make five decisions.
Buy 30 days of evidence.
slides.subtitle: AI data marketplace • founder review • 9 September 2026

slides.title: The recommendation in one page
slides.headline: Form lightly. Validate narrowly. Build only after paid proof.
cards: Rights-cleared corrosion/NDT visual and ultrasonic inspection cases
Concierge exchange first; software follows repeatable workflow evidence
3–5 funded buyer briefs • 10 rights-plausible datasets • 1 paid proof
slides.callout: RECOMMENDATION  Release a gated $5,000—not a platform budget.
slides.source: PROJECT.md • ROADMAP.md • wedge decision • planning judgment

slides.title: Five decisions requested from Tony
rows: Approve as operating assumption; counsel + CPA confirm
Advance to knockout/full clearance; keep 2 backups
Visual + ultrasonic cases; rights manifest required
Agents prepare; humans authorize external action
Release only against four evidence gates
slides.source: Handoff • formation plan • naming research • wedge decision

slides.title: Florida now—unless the facts say otherwise
slides.headline: Optimize for operating reality, not startup folklore.
left: Recommended if Florida is Tony’s principal operating state
One-state setup can reduce duplicate agents, filings and administration
Fits a closely held, validation-stage LLC before institutional financing
right: Delaware: defer absent investor/governance reason; may add foreign qualification
Wyoming: defer absent a specific legal, privacy or cost advantage
Counsel + CPA must confirm nexus, tax, fees and financing implications
slides.callout: GATE  Confirm residence, principal office, hiring footprint and financing path before filing.
slides.source: Formation action plan • FL Sunbiz • DE Division of Corporations • WY Secretary of State • planning judgment

slides.title: Use AssetCorpus as the working name
slides.headline: Enterprise-clear, extensible and aligned to physical-asset data.
options: More ownable; may imply field service
slides.callout: PRELIMINARY SCREEN ONLY  No name, domain or trademark is cleared or reserved.

slides.title: Brand the trust layer—not the marketplace hype
slides.headline: Rare industrial evidence, handled with proof and restraint.
pillars: Find what models cannot scrape—without surrendering control
Deep navy • signal teal • slate • documentary white
slides.source: Brand options deck • naming research • planning judgment

slides.title: Start where scarcity and value are visible
slides.headline: Corrosion/NDT wins the first proof cycle.
slides.callout: STOP if chain of title cannot be documented.
slides.source: Wedge decision, 2026-09-09 • scores are reasoned estimates, not transaction data

slides.title: A researched universe—not a sales pipeline
left: Industrial AI, NDT software, robotics, asset integrity
Use the list to prioritize interviews and referrals
Qualification requires need, timing, authority path and budget signal
right: Inspection contractors, TIC firms, labs, operators, OEM ecosystems
Inventory metadata first; do not take raw sensitive data
Qualification requires asset, provenance path and commercial authority
slides.source: Customer pipeline CSV • provider pipeline CSV • marketing plan

slides.title: Agents accelerate the work; humans hold authority
slides.callout: Default state: draft-only. Every external commitment requires a named human approver.

slides.title: Thirty days to a continue / pivot / stop decision
weeks: Confirm state/name inputs • lock records, controls and interview targets
Approve outreach • run buyer/provider interviews • capture evidence
Draft buyer briefs • qualify inventories • rights triage • match dossiers
Offer a paid prep pilot/license pathway • close metrics • decide next 30 days

slides.title: Choose validation—not acceleration
tiers: Formation prep, core records, basic tools
Too little to test both sides deeply
Interviews, professional review, CRM/enrichment, live-match reserve
slides.callout: Budget ranges are management planning assumptions—not quotes, forecasts or authorization.

slides.title: Release $5,000 in four evidence gates
gates: Release now after Tony confirms operating facts
After name and wedge selection; scoped adviser review
After approved lists, copy, privacy rules and metrics
Only with a credible buyer–provider match or pilot path
slides.source: Handoff • formation plan • marketing plan • planning judgment

slides.title: Evidence determines whether the venture earns more capital
metrics: 3–5 similar written briefs with credible budgets
Paid license or buyer-funded preparation pilot
Deal value covers diligence + sourcing; repeatable workflow
kill: Rights cannot transfer for the best assets
Requirements remain bespoke or parties bypass the service

slides.title: The control system is part of the product
risks: Evidence-linked rights manifest; counsel gate; stop transfer
Site identity, people or sensitive operations
Metadata-first; least privilege; controlled samples; logs
No public marketplace; stage tooling after paid proof
Draft-only default; explicit approval tokens and audit trail
slides.source: AI-native operating system • formation plan • wedge decision

slides.title: What we will not build or buy yet
items: No auction engine, generalized platform or self-serve listings
No custody of sensitive datasets before security + rights gates
No trademark filing, premium domain or campaign before clearance
Use founder outreach, interviews and targeted referrals first
No engineering or sales hiring until workflow and economics repeat
slides.callout: Lightweight internal intake, CRM, passport and audit tools are allowed only to support evidence collection.

slides.footer: Next action after approval: schedule counsel/CPA scope and authorize Gate 1 only.
